item.title: College keelboat racing coming to PNW
item.description: The Storm Trysail Club will be expanding its Intercollegiate Offshore Regatta (IOR) schedule in 2026. Along with the East Coast IOR and Great Lakes IOR will be the addition of the Pacific Coast Intercollegiate Offshore Regatta in the Pacific Northwest. - Details

item.title: Curmudgeon’s Observation
item.description: When cannibals ate a missionary, they got a taste of religion. Providing “insight” since 1997, the Curmudgeon’s Observation has been a hallmark of the Scuttlebutt Newsletter which delivers a digest of major sailing news, commentary, opinions, features and dock talk…with a North American focus.
